// path: The product code only — the 5 packages' src. Tooling (scripts/, tools/) + the centralized tests/ mirror are excluded below.
// formats: The languages in play. `tsx` is REQUIRED to see the client — jscpd's `typescript` format does NOT tokenize .tsx, so without this the whole client (207 .tsx files) is invisible to the gate.
// minLines: 5 lines minimum — below this it's coincidence.
// maxLines: 2000 — handle large generated files without bailing.
// threshold: CI gate: fail if duplication exceeds 5%. Ratchet down as the codebase matures.
// ignore: Tests are the centralized tests/ tree (intentional mirror duplication is fine); migrations are generated; fixtures are data; reset.d.ts is a one-liner.
// ignorePattern: Ignore import blocks that are naturally identical across files.
// ignoreCase: Ignore case of symbols in code to catch stylistic renames.
// reporters: Console for interactive use; `pnpm cpd:report` emits the HTML to reports/cpd.
// skipComments: Strip comments before tokenising — don't match comment boilerplate.
// noTips: Suppress sponsor/AI tips in CI output.
